name: ipo-trademark-registration-outcome
description: For a UK domestic trade mark application filed 2010-2016 - known at filing: mark text, Nice class coverage, category, mark type, series flag and series size, owner country/region/postcode area, filing date - will the mark reach registration as resolved in the IPO's frozen February-2018 open-data snapshot (Registered date recorded)? Unresolved applications at the snapshot (still in examination, opposition or appeal) are censored, never scored.
split: cohort split on filing year: train 2010-2012, eval 2013-2014, holdout 2015-2016
split_description: cohort split on filing year: train 2010-2012, eval 2013-2014, holdout 2015-2016; population is domestic applications with a parseable filing date inside a cohort window; marks whose outcome is unresolved at the frozen 2018-02-13 snapshot are censored - excluded and counted per cohort, never labelled negative
